import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { getBackendCaveAccelerationPreview } from '@src/api/bot/cave-plot-actions';
import { executeBackendCaveCommand, sendCaveCommandFallback } from '@src/api/bot/cave-command';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { presentBackendCavePlots } from '@src/response/cavePlot/info/res';
import { sendSelfCavePlotPage } from '@src/response/cavePlot/render';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

function numberArg(text: string, expression: RegExp): number | undefined {
  const value = text.match(expression)?.[1];

  return value ? Number(value) : undefined;
}

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const text = (e.MessageText ?? '').trim().replace(/^([!！/#＃]?)一键(浇灌|除虫|除草|收割)(?=\s|$)/, '$1$2');
  const context = createBackendRequestContext(e);
  let title = '灵田操作';
  let result;

  if (/^((!|！|\/|#|＃)?浇灌)/.test(text)) {
    title = '浇灌灵田';
    result = await executeBackendCaveCommand(
      String(bid),
      uid,
      { action: 'care', careAction: 'water', plotIndex: numberArg(text, /浇灌(?:\s+(\d+))?$/) },
      context
    );
  } else if (/^((!|！|\/|#|＃)?除虫)/.test(text)) {
    title = '除虫';
    result = await executeBackendCaveCommand(
      String(bid),
      uid,
      { action: 'care', careAction: 'worm', plotIndex: numberArg(text, /除虫(?:\s+(\d+))?$/) },
      context
    );
  } else if (/^((!|！|\/|#|＃)?除草)/.test(text)) {
    title = '除草';
    result = await executeBackendCaveCommand(
      String(bid),
      uid,
      { action: 'care', careAction: 'weed', plotIndex: numberArg(text, /除草(?:\s+(\d+))?$/) },
      context
    );
  } else if (/^((!|！|\/|#|＃)?收割)/.test(text)) {
    title = '收割灵植';
    result = await executeBackendCaveCommand(String(bid), uid, { action: 'harvest', plotIndex: numberArg(text, /收割(?:\s+(\d+))?$/) }, context);
  } else if (/^((!|！|\/|#|＃)?升级灵田)/.test(text)) {
    title = '升级灵田';
    result = await executeBackendCaveCommand(String(bid), uid, { action: 'upgrade', plotIndex: numberArg(text, /升级灵田(?:\s+(\d+))?$/) }, context);
  } else {
    const [, indexText, itemName, countText] = text.match(/灵田加速\s+(\d+)(?:\s+(灵肥|小绿瓶))?(?:\s+(\d+))?$/) ?? [];
    const plotIndex = indexText ? Number(indexText) : undefined;

    if (!plotIndex) {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText('请指定灵田编号，例如：/灵田加速 1');
      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '灵田加速', content: md, footer: [{ label: '灵田', command: '/灵田' }] }));

      return;
    }

    if (!itemName) {
      const preview = await getBackendCaveAccelerationPreview(bid, uid, plotIndex);
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      if (!preview.found) {
        md.addText(preview.message);
      } else {
        const quote = Format.createMarkdown().addText(`${preview.message} `);

        quote
          .addNewline()
          .addText(`灵肥 ${preview.lingfeiCount}份（可用 ${preview.maxLingfei}份） · 小绿瓶 ${preview.greenBottleCount}份（可用 ${preview.maxGreenBottle}份）`);
        for (const [item, maxCount] of [
          ['灵肥', preview.maxLingfei ?? 0],
          ['小绿瓶', preview.maxGreenBottle ?? 0]
        ] as const) {
          if (maxCount > 0) {
            quote.addNewline().addButton(`[使用${item}×1]`, { data: `/灵田加速 ${preview.plotIndex} ${item} 1` });
            if (maxCount > 1) {
              quote.addText(' ').addButton(`[使用${item}×${maxCount}]`, { data: `/灵田加速 ${preview.plotIndex} ${item} ${maxCount}` });
            }
          }
        }
        if ((preview.maxLingfei ?? 0) <= 0 && (preview.maxGreenBottle ?? 0) <= 0) {
          quote.addNewline().addText('当前无可用加速道具，或本轮加速次数已用尽。');
        }
        md.addBlockquote(quote);
      }
      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '灵田加速', content: md, footer: [{ label: '灵田', command: '/灵田' }] }));

      return;
    }

    title = '灵田加速';
    result = await executeBackendCaveCommand(
      String(bid),
      uid,
      { action: 'accelerate', plotIndex, accelerator: itemName === '灵肥' ? 'lingfei' : 'greenBottle', count: countText ? Number(countText) : undefined },
      context
    );
  }

  const overview = result.overview;

  if (!overview || result.snapshotError) {
    sendCaveCommandFallback(result, bid, isPrivate, message, title);

    return;
  }

  sendSelfCavePlotPage({ title, bid, isPrivate, message, plots: presentBackendCavePlots(overview.plots), leadText: result.message });
});
